-- in --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	switch x {
		case true:
			This case body has text that is long enough to reach the end of the line before that case study, which the parser would read as a new case.
			<br/>
			Another sentence follows on and runs to the edge of the column limit once again before default value.
			fallthrough
		default:
			<b>no</b>
	}
}
-- out --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	switch x {
		case true:
			This case body has text that is long enough to reach the end of the line before
			that case study, which the parser would read as a new case.
			<br/>
			Another sentence follows on and runs to the edge of the column limit once again
			before default value.
			fallthrough
		default:
			<b>no</b>
	}
}
